claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 22 September 1866, p. 6, col. 2 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 26 September 1866, p. 3, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The steamship Atlantic, Captain Hoyer, which left
Southampton on the 10th of September, arrived at this
port yesterday afternoon.[cut]
Our European files by the Atlantic are dated on Mon-
day, the 10th of September, two days later than the
papers to hand by the Java, and contain interesting de-
tails of our despatches by the cable to that day.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 26 September 1866, p. 6, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The steamship Atlantic, from Southampton, August
10, reached this port yesterday, bringing our files from
London dated on her day of sailing.
